Good to know

Frequently asked questions

Can I sign up for broadband today?

Not yet. KiwiKind is a pre-launch project, not an operating internet service provider.

Will KiwiKind offer cheaper fibre?

Affordable fibre is our goal. We cannot promise prices until wholesale costs and business requirements are confirmed.

Is there an Android app?

An Android app is in development. It isn't available for public customer use yet.

Can I check availability or pay?

No. Coverage checks, orders and payments are disabled until the service is ready.

PRIVACY · PRELAUNCH · 17 OCTOBER 2026

Privacy, in plain language.

KiwiKind Broadband is a prelaunch project. Support, privacy and account-deletion contact: kiwikindbroadband@gmail.com. Public broadband intake remains closed.

Our full privacy policy explains account information, Google sign-in, support messages, hosting providers, security, retention and your choices.

You can request access, correction or deletion without signing in. Request account deletion, including for Google-only accounts without a KiwiKind password. Account exports and password-protected deletion requests remain available in the portal.

If a privacy concern remains unresolved, you can contact the Office of the Privacy Commissioner.

DRAFT · PRE-LAUNCH · VERSION prelaunch-2026-10-16

A request is just a request.

KiwiKind Broadband is a working brand for a planned New Zealand broadband retail business. It is not yet offering a live broadband service. The legal supplier and contact details must be confirmed before customer intake opens.

Creating an account or submitting a request does not form a broadband service contract, guarantee availability, start provisioning, authorise switching or create any charge. Don’t cancel your current broadband on the basis of a request. You may cancel a pending request in the portal.

Only submit accurate details for an address you are authorised to enquire about. Protect your password. Support tickets and complaints are recorded in your account; no pre-launch response time is promised. We do not claim Telecommunications Dispute Resolution membership. A live complaints and escalation process must be approved before service launch.

Any future offer needs separate acceptance of confirmed pricing, GST, speeds and limitations, installation, equipment, minimum term, cancellation and switching terms. Nothing here excludes rights that cannot lawfully be excluded under New Zealand law, including applicable Consumer Guarantees Act and Fair Trading Act protections. These draft portal terms require review before public customer use.
